Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) is a diverse lung condition marked by persistent airflow limitation and respiratory symptoms of shortness of breath, cough, and exacerbations; resulting from structural abnormalities in the airways (Bronchitis) or in the alveoli (Emphysema). It is usually caused by significant exposure to noxious particles or gases.
